newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Nike Inc low on steam.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Nike Inc low on steam.

text.p: Shares in Nike Inc dropped slightly in after-hours trading as the shoe and apparel maker released fiscal fourth quarter earnings just beneath analysts' expectations, traders said.
Dealers said Nike stock traded at 58 after the bell, under an unofficial close of 58 13/16.

Nike waited until late in the day to post fourth quarter earnings of $0.52 per share, up from $0.45 for the year ago-period. A First Call consensus of 17 brokers anticipated Nike earnings for the fourth quarter of $0.53 a share.
Pennzoil Co, meanwhile, was halted for after-hours trade as its chairman announced the oil company had rejected a hostile bid by Union Pacific Resources Inc.
UPR offered $84 per share cash and stock, a bid that Pennzoil chairman James Pate characterized as "inadequate."
Pate also said Pennzoil would match or exceed First Call estimates of $0.69 per share on second quarter earnings.
UPR also did not trade after hours.
"It's quiet after the close," a trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 175,400 from 137,300 the previous day. Session two volume fell to 4.8 million from Monday's 7.6 million.
